entries.text: Thank you for calling VeloFit customer support. Your call may be monitored for quality assurance. How can I help you today?
Hi, I recently received a VeloFit bike, and unfortunately, it arrived damaged.
I'm so sorry to hear that your bike arrived damaged. Could you please describe the damage in more detail?

Well, the box was pretty beat up, and now I see why. The frame itself has a visible crack, a pretty noticeable cracked frame, and the front wheel seems to have a wobbly wheel. I think it's definitely from shipping damage.

I understand. That sounds incredibly frustrating. I sincerely apologize for the shipping damage and the condition your bike arrived in. To resolve this immediately, I'm happy to offer you a full refund. Would that work for you?
A refund would be great, yes.

Excellent. I've processed the full refund for you. It should reflect in your account within 5-7 business days. We'll also send you a free label to return the damaged bike. You don't need to worry about return shipping costs.
Oh, that's wonderful! So you're sending me a free label?

Yes, absolutely. You'll receive an email within the next hour with the free label and instructions on how to return the bike. Just box it back up as best as you can, attach the label, and drop it off at your nearest shipping location. Again, I apologize for the inconvenience caused by the cracked frame and wobbly wheel resulting from the shipping damage.
Okay, perfect! Thank you so much for your help!
You're very welcome! Is there anything else I can assist you with today?
No, that's all. Thank you again!
You have a great day! Thank you for choosing VeloFit.
